rows.note: Use this for physical expansion, especially when materials expand because of heat.

example.english: The rails undergo expansion when it gets hot, so space must be left between them.
example.traditional: 天氣一熱，條鐵軌就會膨脹，所以中間要留位。

rows.note: Use this specifically for a period in which the economy grows and market activity increases.

example.english: The report says this period of economic expansion has led to a continued fall in unemployment.
example.traditional: 報告指出，今次經濟擴張令失業率持續下降。

rows.note: Use this for extra content sold or used with an existing game or other product.

example.english: The game's expansion will be released next month and will add new maps and characters.
example.traditional: 呢隻遊戲嘅擴充包下個月推出，會加入新地圖同角色。
